I gave my blood samples yesterday afternoon, and they clearly told me I’d get the reports by the next afternoon as per their TAT. I waited, but nothing came.

- LFT/RFT with Serum Electrolyte
- CRP

The whole thing felt very unprofessional. Different explanations, delays, and no proper clarity. It honestly felt misleading.

If my review can help even one person avoid this kind of experience, then it’s worth putting it out here.
